name: wikikit
description: Agentic toolkit for Wikimedians: translate articles between any two wikis with links, categories, templates and references intact; find missing articles; draft Wikidata statements; port templates; verify citations. Read-only by design: you draft, a human publishes.

contact.title: Contact for the Wikimedia User-Agent
contact.description: Your email or wiki user page. Wikimedia's User-Agent policy requires automated clients to be contactable.

workdir.title: Work directory
workdir.description: Where translation jobs, worklists and your own language profiles are kept (default: ~/WikiWork).

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: Enables Jev for fast, calibrated citation checks and bulk screening. Leave empty to have Claude do these itself.
